credits.aiBody: This game was largely created with the help of artificial intelligence: both the code and the card images are mostly AI-generated.
credits.thanksBody: Special thanks to my wonderful girlfriend, and her sister, for helping me move this project forward!
credits.musicBody: "CHIRAC - Je serai le président de tous les Français (TOMALY House remix)" by Tomaly, based on the original track by Malto. Big thanks to both of them!
credits.musicRemixLink: Listen to the remix on SoundCloud
credits.musicOriginalLink: Listen to the original on YouTube
credits.privacyBody: The game is 100% anonymous: no account, no personal data collection. Only ads may collect data, and only with your consent (they can be disabled in the settings).
credits.disclaimerBody: This game is meant purely for fun. The votes are never manipulated, and the results reflect only how players swipe — not reality, and no political truth of any kind. Nothing here should be taken seriously, nor used to judge, target, or harass anyone. I decline any affiliation and any responsibility for how the content is interpreted, and I wholeheartedly encourage kindness, respect, and good values. Play, laugh, and be nice to one another.
